app.name: SecureVibe
app.tagline: Design, build and verify a secure web application without writing security code yourself
app.description: SecureVibe is a local-first tool that walks a non-technical person through describing a web application, designs it following the OWASP Secure by Design Framework, generates the code with Claude, and verifies the result against OWASP ASVS and AISVS. This profile describes SecureVibe itself, assessed the same way it assesses the applications it builds.
keyFeatures: Guided wizard that turns plain-language answers into a security design
Generates a hardened web application with Claude, inside a fixed security contract
Runs static analysis, dependency checks, secret scanning, a dynamic scan and an AI review on what was built
Produces a compliance report and a security report for the generated application
Runs its own verification pipeline against itself (this file)

externalApis.name: Anthropic API
externalApis.purpose: generates and reviews the code of applications the user designs

externalApis.name: npm registry
externalApis.purpose: installs the packages a generated application depends on
